import json, sys, time, random, base64; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj

# 4096 states, 16384 transitions (4 outgoing each), 2048 runs, guards on all transitions
NSTATES = 4096
NTRANS = 16384
states = ["q%04d" % i for i in range(NSTATES)]
types = [
  {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 16},
  {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 8},
  {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": states},
  {"name": "Big", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["f%d" % i, "U8"] for i in range(16)]},
  {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "Big", "size": 4},
]
modules = [{"name": "entry", "params": [["state", "State"], ["msg", "Str"], ["blk", "Arr"]],
            "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None}]
transitions = []
rng = random.Random(7)
for i in range(NTRANS):
    src = states[i % NSTATES]
    dst = states[(i * 7 + 3) % NSTATES]
    transitions.append({"from": src, "to": dst, "command": "c%03d" % (i % 900),
                        "cost": 1 + (i % 9),
                        "when": ["lt", ["var", "blk", "f0"], ["const", "U8", 60000]] if i % 2 else None})
# ensure a chain exists
for i in range(NSTATES - 1):
    transitions[i] = {"from": states[i], "to": states[i + 1], "command": "a%03d" % (i % 900),
                      "cost": 1, "when": None}
machine = {"states": states, "initial": "q0000", "state_param": "state", "message_param": "msg",
           "transitions": transitions}
# harness: state x0(4), msg x1 buffer + 8 chars x2..x9, blk: Arr x10, Big structs x11,x27,x43,x59 each 16 fields
runs = []
for k in range(2048):
    objs = [obj("x0", (k * 37) % NSTATES, 4)]
    for i in range(8):
        objs.append(obj("x%d" % (2 + i), 0x61 + (i % 26) if i < 3 else 0, 1))
    for j in range(4 * 16):
        objs.append(obj("x%d" % (11 + j), (k + j) % 60000, 2))
    objs.append(obj("x4" if False else "x%d" % (11 + 4 * 16), 0, 2))
    runs.append({"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest(objs)})
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["entry"],
       "machine": machine, "runs": runs}
json.dump(doc, open('/workspace/tmp/scale.json', 'w'))
print("slots check")
import subprocess
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py"],
                   stdin=open('/workspace/tmp/scale.json','rb'), capture_output=True)
print("elapsed %.2fs rc=%d stderr=%s" % (time.time() - t, p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:300]))
out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print("variables", out["plans"][0]["variables"], "slots", len(out["plans"][0]["slots"]))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(r["status"] for r in out["records"]))
print("corpus", len(out["corpus"]), "max commands", max((len(c["commands"]) for c in out["corpus"]), default=0))
PYEOF
